signals.label: Lifetime definition
signals.finding: 2 low-star reviews say lifetime access was cut back or moved behind a subscription.

evidence.quote: important features seem to be locked behind higher-tier plans without clear upfront visibility.
CSV export and billable hours/actuals either are or will be locked behind a paid plan starting at $218.75/month (billed annually).

signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: The deal says "unlimited", but the vendor's own pages meter usage. 3 reviews say limits were reduced.

evidence.quote: The free cloud plan supports unlimited users and up to 3 active projects.
The Pro plan ($69/month yearly) includes 15 users and supports up to 50 users with unlimited projects.
you can only choose between tasks assigned to me or by me, without being able to see the full team workflow
it's really really great if we could have guest users without counting as users

signals.label: Support complaints
signals.finding: 3 reviews (12.5% of all) say support is slow or gone.

evidence.quote: AND no customer support for things that don't work or I did wrong?
support won’t be back online until 11:30 PM EST
the developers were slow to respond so I decided to move to another project management app

signals.label: Review trend
signals.finding: Newest 20 reviews average 3.75/5 vs 3.92/5 all-time (-0.17). 29% of all reviews are 1-2 stars.

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The cheapest tier is a usable slice of the product.

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $79 vs a stated $249 regular price (68% off).

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change features or pricing at any time.

trials.claim: Plan 1 includes lifetime access to Worklenz for $79 (was $249)
trials.claimQuote:
### Plan 1: $79 (was $249)
- Lifetime access to Worklenz
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
trials.reasoning: The binding terms say the vendor can modify or discontinue any part of the service without notice and grants only a limited, revocable license during the term. That materially limits the promised lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: We reserve the right at any time and from time to time to modify or discontinue, temporarily or permanently, any part of the Service with or without notice.
exhibits.argument: Vendor can discontinue any part of the service without notice, which undermines a promise of lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: CeyDigital hereby grants you a limited, revocable, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-sub licensable right and license during the term to access and use the portions of the Platform.
exhibits.argument: Access is described as limited and revocable during the term, not as permanent lifetime ownership.
